[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:380YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>The Empire recognises the importance of extant and future trade in strategic materials with our allies in Jarm and welcomes any overtures to strengthen existing agreements or form new ones.
<br>
<i>Proposed by Upwold, Seconded by Morrow</i></ic>

===Overview===
* Passed

===Date===
* Autumn 380YE
===Outcome===
* The motion secured favoured trading status for the Principalities of Jarm, resulting in an increased amount of crystal mana available on the docks.
* The motion was [[Abrogate_Jarmish_favoured_nation_status|later abrogated]] during the Autumn Equinox 382YE.
